Name: Better Weapons
Author: dendenhsmy
Description:
Rusty Sword: Longer attack cooldown

Silver Saber: Attack three times quickly

Dark Sword: Become invincible for a while

Galaxy Sword: Quickly attack forward four times, invincible during this period

Bone Sword: Block and fire a bone projectile

Iron Edge: It has not changed

Templar's Blade: Has enchantment: crusader

Obsidian Edge: Dash forward and attack twice

Lava Katana: Block and fire five fireballs

Claymore: Cause a small explosion

Steel Smallsword: Shorter attack cooldown

Wooden Blade: It has not change

Insect Head: Attack three times quickly and have an enchantment: Bug Killer

Neptune's Glaive: Fire two projectiles with low speed and high damage

Forest Sword: Fire three high-speed projectiles

Carving Knife: Shorter attack cooldown

Iron Dirk: It has not change

Burglar's Shank: Dash attack and return

Shadow Dagger: Become invincible for a while

Elf Blade: Fire a projectile with a very low cooldown

Crystal Dagger: Attack six times quickly

Wind Spire: Rush forward, invincible during the period

Galaxy Dagger: Attack six times quickly, invincible during the period

Wood Club: It has not change

Lead Rod: Hammer the ground and causing an explosion

Wood Mallet: Shorter attack cooldown

The Slammer: Hammer the ground and cause a big explosion

Galaxy Hammer: Hammer the ground and cause a small explosion with low cooldown

Femur: Hammer the ground and fire a bone projectile

Pirate's Sword: Get a small number of coins after killing enemies

Cutlass: Spin around to attack

Wicked Kris: Summon a bolt of lightning to attack the enemy

Kudgel: Rush forward and attack

Yeti Tooth: Fire a large number of low-damage projectiles

Rapier: Shorter attack cooldown

Steel Falchion: It has not change

Broken Trident: Rush forward, invincible during the period

Tempered Broadsword: Spin around to attack

Dwarf Sword, Dwarf Hammer, Dwarf Dagger: Cause explosions and lightning

Dragontooth Cutlass, Dragontooth Club, 
Dragontooth Shiv: Launch dragon tooth projectiles that can rebound

Iridium Needle: Advance and attack forward

Infinity Blade: Quickly attack four times and summon lightning, invincible during this period

Infinity Gavel: Hammer the ground and causing an explosion, with extremely high explosion damage

Infinity Dagger: Rush forward three times and summon lightning

Downloads.Description: This mod changes the special attack of almost all weapons
